criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests or inquiries about closing or deleting a bank account.

categories.name: Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Reports of transactions or charges that the customer did not authorize.

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to card usage, including declined transactions, lost or stolen cards, and card activation.

categories.name: PIN and Security
categories.definition: Inquiries about changing, setting, or issues with card PINs and security checks.

categories.name: Transfers and Payments
categories.definition: Questions or issues related to transferring funds, pending payments, and payment reversals.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems or questions regarding topping up accounts, including pending or failed top-ups.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees, charges, and exchange rates applied to transactions.

categories.name: Card Delivery
categories.definition: Questions about the delivery status or tracking of new or replacement cards.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions related to verifying identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Virtual and Disposable Cards
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining or using virtual or disposable cards.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about currency exchange rates and fees.

categories.name: Account Access
categories.definition: Issues related to accessing the account or app, including password or passcode resets.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered at ATMs, such as incorrect cash amounts or card retention.

categories.name: Account Information Update
categories.definition: Requests to update personal information, such as address or name changes.

categories.name: Refunds
categories.definition: Inquiries about refunds for transactions or purchases.

categories.name: General Inquiries
categories.definition: Miscellaneous questions not covered by other categories, such as bank locations or supported currencies.
